propositions: The review-bot-ops runbook lacks the prod instance ID and AWS region needed for operators to start SSM sessions, forcing them to guess values that are actually defined in terraform

The instance ID i-00880b2c7f13527c5 and region us-east-1 (sourced from var.aws_region and versions.tf) must be documented in the operational runbook as a 'The box' reference section with account and SSM connect commands
The autodeploy.sh script body auto-updates via BOT_PATHS rsync like other source code, but script-only changes are not deployed until the next full bot-path deploy without a manual hand-deploy
The autodeploy installer (install-autodeploy.sh) and systemd unit files are excluded from in-run re-materialization to prevent self-modification races and always require hand-deployment
Documentation must clarify that autodeploy.sh self-updates are governed by rsync behavior, not by explicit exclusion logic
